    Who We Are

    Your Car Deserves
    Expert Car Care

    Apex Auto Detailing brings careful cleaning and attention to every surface of your vehicle. From the cabin to the paintwork, our goal is a finish you can feel proud of.

    Choose a maintenance wash, a cabin refresh or a complete detail. We assess your vehicle first and explain the available options, scope and expected time before work begins.

    Every vehicle has different needs. Tell us about yours and we can help you choose the right care, whether you drive a compact hatchback, a sedan, a crossover or an SUV.

    • Paint Protection Film (PPF)
    • Complete Detailing
    • Compound polishing with DA machine
    • Ceramic coating ( 1 to 5 years)
    • Sound Damping
    • Solar Tints Nanotek
    • Premium Oil Changing

      Explore paint cleaning and polishing options after a surface inspection, with the expected finish and scope explained first.

      Get a Quote

      Ceramic Coating

      Ask about coating options and availability. Preparation, coverage and protection terms must be confirmed for your vehicle.

      Get a Quote

      Paint Protection Film (PPF)

      Ask about protective film options, installation coverage and availability. A written quote can be prepared after inspection.

      Get a Quote

      Oil Change

      Get a Quote

      Explore cabin insulation options and ask about installation areas, material choices and service availability.

      Get a Quote

      Discuss window film options, visibility and heat reduction. Confirm product specifications and local requirements before installation.

    How It Works

    Our Simple Process

    We know your time is valuable — so we made every step fast, transparent and hassle-free.

    01 / 04
    01
    Step 01

    Booking

    The fastest way to get your car in our hands

    Share your vehicle type, the service you need and a preferred date. We will discuss availability and help you plan your visit.

    • Discuss your preferred appointment
    • Availability confirmed before booking
    • Appointment details shared with you
    02
    Step 02

    Vehicle Check‑In

    Zero surprises — we document everything before we begin

    Before starting, we check the vehicle together, agree on the work and quote, and explain when it should be ready.

    • Full exterior and interior condition noted
    • Package confirmed on the spot
    • Estimated completion time given upfront
    03
    Step 03

    Service in Progress

    Expert hands. Premium products. Every single time.

    Your selected treatment is carried out with tools and products suited to each surface. The work is checked before handover.

    • professional car-care grade products
    • Professional equipment at every stage
    • Quality checked throughout the process
    04
    Step 04

    Delivery & Payment

    Pick up your car gleaming — pay however suits you

    Review the finished detail with us, ask about aftercare and settle the agreed amount using a confirmed payment method.

    • Ask about available payment methods
    • No hidden charges or surprise fees
    • Quick WhatsApp feedback — we love to improve
